details: The postinstall hook of this scoped package (a combosquat of the element-plus-vite-cli tool) checks whether the installing project matches a hardcoded target workspace (package name mall4cloud-react with exact content digests). When it matches, the hook decrypts an AES-256-GCM-encrypted agent runtime (key derived from the workspace fingerprint) and launches it as a detached background process under ~/.gradle/caches/transforms-3/8.7/instrumented/.../instrumentation-agent-runtime.mjs. The agent registers the host (hostname, username, OS) to hxxps://npmjs[.]it[.]com/api/register, then polls hxxps://npmjs[.]it[.]com/api/task/{agentId} every ~5s for commands. It supports arbitrary shell execution (exec), directory listing (ls), file exfiltration to hxxps://npmjs[.]it[.]com/api/file/{agentId}/{taskId}, file upload/write, file deletion, process listing, and file moves. The C2 base URL can be overridden via the C2_SERVER_URL environment variable.
